title: Analysis of Federated Aggregation under Model Poisoning and Backdoor Attacks: A Reconstructed Cross-Dataset and Cross-Architecture Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.11423v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robust comparisons of federated aggregation methods require joint consideration of predictive performance, threat definitions, metric semantics, and execution provenance. A 500-cell seed-1 evaluation matrix was reconstructed across five aggregation methods, five datasets, five architectures, and four recorded conditions: clean, sign-flipping, Gaussian, and BadNets. Successful execution logs were identified for 454 original runs and 36 repaired or rerun executions, whereas 10 clean SVHN cells were supported by summary-only provenance. Trimmed Mean achieved the highest clean macro-mean accuracy (76.02%) and the lowest mean within-task rank (1.70). Krum attained the highest recorded accuracy under both sign-flipping and Gaussian configurations. translated_title: 联邦聚合在模型投毒与后门攻击下的分析：重构的跨数据集与跨架构基准
translated_abstract: 摘要：对联邦聚合方法的稳健比较需要联合考虑预测性能、威胁定义、度量语义和执行来源。我们重构了一个包含500个单元格的种子-1评估矩阵，涵盖五种聚合方法、五个数据集、五种架构和四种记录条件：干净、符号翻转、高斯和BadNets。在454个原始运行和36个修复或重跑执行中识别出成功执行日志，而10个干净的SVHN单元格仅由摘要级来源支持。修剪均值在干净条件下达到了最高的宏平均准确率（76.02%）和最低的任务内平均排名（1.70）。Krum在符号翻转和高斯配置下均达到了最高记录准确率。当分析仅限于21个任务对（其中每个方法-条件组合都有原始成功日志）时，这些相对排名保持不变。对提供的审计...
tldr: 本文重构了一个跨数据集和架构的联邦聚合基准，发现修剪均值和Krum分别在干净及攻击场景下表现最优，且排名在严格审计下保持稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper reconstructs a cross-dataset and cross-architecture benchmark for federated aggregation, finding that Trimmed Mean and Krum perform best under clean and attack scenarios, respectively, with rankings remaining stable under strict audit.
